Profile

A mid-level Design Documenter and Architectural Drafter with six years of experience producing coordinated CD sets, Revit models, and construction documentation to NCC and WA R-Code standards — across commercial, hospitality, and residential projects in Europe, now based in Perth and available part-time.

I specialise in managing the production of comprehensive drawing sets — often exceeding 100+ sheets — for global commercial environments. This high-volume practice has honed my ability to maintain technical accuracy and cross-trade coordination under tight deadlines.

I prioritise safety and accessibility in every project, ensuring strict adherence to the National Construction Code (NCC), WA R-Codes, and AS1428.1 standards. Now based in Perth, I am deepening my Australian standards knowledge through a Diploma and Advanced Diploma in Civil Construction Design at Keystone College of Business & Technology (Perth CBD), and am currently leading documentation for a live residential project in North Perth. Available part-time, I integrate efficiently into existing studio workflows with minimal onboarding.
